placedBecause: a campaign instrument that runs as its own process

witness.recorder: The test re-reads the mutated file off disk with Path.read_text and compares it against the text the splice should have produced, byte for byte — the same read-back apply() itself performs, done independently by the caller so the instrument's own claim is not the evidence for it. The refusal paths are witnessed the same way: the file is read back and compared against the bytes it held before the call.

armedBy: Two-way in one run: the landing splice is witnessed changing the file, and each refusal is witnessed leaving it byte-identical. Removing the offset check reds 9 checks and removing the read-back reds 1, both watched.
